cover_metadata.cover_rule: Open with the decision context and never reproduce a Markdown table of contents.

tables.overflow: Split by decision point across slides with repeated headers and stable source notes.

callouts.rule: Use one dominant callout per slide with a text label and source binding.

diagram_placement.rule: Use one legible decision-relevant diagram per slide, bound to a declared diagram slot and source section.

image_placement.rule: Use images as evidence or experience anchors, preserve aspect ratio, and bind each to an approved image slot.

captions_alt_text.rule: Captions identify evidence and date; alt text conveys the message needed when the visual is unavailable.

headers_footers.footer: Owner, version, source-note marker, and slide number

source_notes.rule: Keep concise source markers on-slide and full evidence, inference limits, and speaking cues in speaker notes.

pagination.orphan_control: Keep titles with their message and never isolate a caption or source marker from its visual.
pagination.overflow_policy: Split into another message-led slide; never shrink below the minimum type size or clip content.
pagination.empty_page_policy: Reject empty, heading-only, duplicated, or accidental trailing slides.
